summary: Frontend-only Playwright validation of the AMP-clone Device Trajectory (/xdr/edr/device-trajectory) against endpoint dev_42e8c6dc74b9. All ~40 requested UX behaviours were exercised end-to-end. The previously reported deep-lane defect is confirmed FIXED — deep rows 300..321 render 22 events / 44 lifelines / 22 connectors and rows 421..442 render 4 events / 44 lifelines / 22 connectors, with the same 'ENDPOINT_WIDE_INVARIANT_TO_VIEWPORT' activity axis. Filters, presets, search, hour-bin/day-cell navigation, drag-pan, event selection, context menu, deep-link locate, fullscreen and legacy regression all pass. No mock data observed anywhere; empty windows honestly show amp-events-empty + amp-canvas-empty + amp-computer-epistemic.
action_items: Optional: expose an `amp-nav-window` data-testid summarising the current window start/end (the review request references it). Currently the window text is embedded inside amp-status and inside the hour-band SEP-6 label; not blocking, but adding the testid would let external tools assert on it directly.

Optional: differentiate the preset click's status feedback — 1d/7d/14d/30d all left amp-status rows count unchanged because window position was preserved; consider updating amp-status or a dedicated amp-nav-window testid when preset changes span.
critical_code_review_comments: Data honesty is respected: 'not collected' labels rendered for Group/Policy/Internal IP/External IP/Definitions Last Updated; Vulnerabilities panel states 'Vulnerability data is not collected by NivXForge — this is an absence of collection, not an absence of vulnerabilities.' Empty windows use amp-events-empty + amp-canvas-empty + amp-computer-epistemic — no fabricated demo values found.

The activity axis is proven endpoint-wide (status text shows axis id '31e681f099dc1ab3 (ENDPOINT_WIDE_INVARIANT_TO_VIEWPORT)') and stays stable while scrolling from row 0 to 300 to 421. This is the exact fix intended for the deep-lane defect.
Parent process column is honest — different parent/child pairs observed (python3.11/bash, python3.11/dash, python3.11/sleep) — child name is not simply repeated as the parent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deep-lane defect is confirmed fixed. To reproduce: login → /xdr/edr/device-trajectory?device=dev_42e8c6dc74b9 → wait ~5s → set [data-testid=amp-vscroll].scrollTop = 300*15.5 (also 421*15.5). Confirm amp-lane-label-{n}, amp-lifeline-* and amp-connector-* elements. Filters live inside amp-filters-menu (opened by amp-filters-button) — presets amp-preset-{1d,7d,14d,30d,all} are inside that same menu, not on the top bar. Event iids contain '#' which must be URL-encoded when building deep-link URLs. The activity axis id shown in amp-status is the stable proof marker.
